hypotheses.title: Decorrelated Gold Breakout: Four High-Conviction Alphas Engineered to Crush the Self-Correlation Barrier
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Directly targets the 0.74 - 0.84 self-correlation bottleneck discovered in Batch 50 while preserving the massive underlying Sharpe power (2.02 - 2.25): (1) Pure 1-Year Call Volatility Term Premium (option8): Strips out the generic price-delta reversal overlay, deploying the Alpha 3 architecture (decay=7) to slash turnover to 11% and drop self-correlation below 0.55 while locking Fitness in the EXCELLENT tier. (2) Pure Analyst Consensus Adjusted Net Income Yield (analyst4): Deploys the clean Alpha 11 architecture (decay=5) on consensus adjusted net income, completely removing technical reversal drag to ensure 0% overlap with options alphas. (3) 1-Year Call Term Premium with Overnight Gap Fade Overlay: Replaces the 5-day delta with an overnight opening price gap reversal ((open - delay(close, 1)) / delay(close, 1)), fading retail opening euphoria without correlating to multi-day price momentum. (4) Long/Short Volatility Arbitrage: Subtracts 2-year put volatility from 1-year call volatility to isolate pure directional institutional skew asymmetry while removing market-wide volatility beta.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if overnight opening gap fades fail to capture retail liquidity exhaustion or if institutional call options premium reflects retail gambling.
